liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Throwback (When We Were Young)**: rare: 14 archived performances [9]
- **Take Me With U**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Peaceful Easy Feeling**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Easy**: back after 300 archived shows (5887 days); rare: 3 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **MMJ2016-05-29.MMJ2016-05-29Redrocks** (recommended): source not stated; 27 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds fantastic with sweet Neumann U89 microphones [5]
- **MMJ2016-05-29.MMJ2016-05-29RedrocksTLM102**: source not stated; 27 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **mmj2016-05-29.ck930.flac24**: source not stated; 27 songs; 182 min [3]
- **mmj2016-05-29.ck930.flac16**: source not stated; 27 songs; 182 min [4]

## Around the show

- Recorder barged into seats, causing security involvement and conflict with production staff [7]
- Recorder claimed taper section rights after friend said group could make room [8]
- Johnny Quaid performed as a guest during the concert [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **MMJ2016-05-29.MMJ2016-05-29Redrocks**: taped by Pat Myers; transferred by Pat Myers AKA Dat Pat; source: Neumann U-89i's (Hyper Setting)-Zoom F-8 [1]. Also: Recorded by Pat Myers using Neumann U-89i microphones with 80Hz roll off [1]
- **MMJ2016-05-29.MMJ2016-05-29RedrocksTLM102**: taped by Pat Myers; transferred by Pat Myers AKA Dat Pat; source: Neumann TLM 102's>Zoom F-8 [2]
- **mmj2016-05-29.ck930.flac24**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant Tinybox > Sony M10 (@24/48) [3]. Also: 24-bit version dedicated to Corey Sandoval, who passed away [3]
- **mmj2016-05-29.ck930.flac16**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant Tinybox > Sony M10 (@24/48) [4]. Also: 16-bit version dedicated to Corey Sandoval, suitable for CD burning [4]
